definition: Full OS means official Linux Mint 22.3 Cinnamon plus the Harbor overlay applied by the operator. Harbor does not fork the kernel and does not host the Mint ISO.

layers.A: Overlay substrate. Independent zip. Ships from this repository.
layers.B: Personal bootable image. Operator verifies linuxmint-22.3-cinnamon-64bit.iso then runs iso/full-os-kit.sh and iso/live-apply.sh or Cubic.
layers.C: Grok App Experimentals chrome. Product decision for xAI. This file is the contract, not the tab.
